title: Telemedical rules (HMI, Minmed, Alliance, Parkway, CGH, KTPH, Noah)
keywords: telemedical medical minmed alliance noah health clinic 9pm pin never moved
body: Medical jobs are never moved; every telemedical job is delivered the same day by 9pm.
Minmed: hourly bookings only, no stacking. Pickup within 30 mins of acceptance or block the agent. Not accepted by 8.30pm → Lalamove. PIN comes from the patient only; never leave unattended.
Noah Health: deliver within 4 hrs (max 1 hr late). Tell the patient the delivery window; no extensions.
PIN requests: POD must confirm hand delivery via WhatsApp or KChat.
